name: sftNN
why: Template for evaluating a Snowball-family SFT checkpoint on AAI-open from main (aa_evals/campaign/SFT_EVAL.md). Edit 3 fields: name (campaign = model id, prefixes registry/run ids/dispatch dirs), models.sft.checkpoint, models.sft.suites ("lean" = TB2.1, AutomationBench, GDPval, SciCode, Omniscience, GDP.pdf as the sb2-* evals; "full" = all 9 suites of c30 cheap_full_v1). Everything else is main's default for SFT evals (11-19).
capped_note: capped-sft-eval-v1 (sha256 403ad91eb358..., the M5 ladder's file, in this checkout), the AAI-open v0.1 protocol; with it the model-time caps default to the 12-h hang backstop (#539). The launcher labels the runs v0.1 when every pin matches, else v0.1+custom (#481)
worker_profile_note: TB2.1 workers 32 slots / 6 CPU (#553): for slow-served models only (prior TB2.1 tool share <= 0.25; Snowball SFTs ~0.22). Set null for a fast-served model.
tbsched_shadow_note: true = after the full launch, a read-only tbsched loop (mode shadow) records what it would decide next to the run (<dispatch_root>/<name>-<model>-sched/), evidence for the tbsched 'on' canary; scores and scheduling unchanged

sft.name: Snowball SFT (describe: base, data, size)
sft.budget_note: fixed 128 agents per GPU (user 11-16; #534): the measured knee of a 2xB200 Snowball server
